# EL PAÍS English

> EL PAÍS English is Spain's leading international news outlet delivering breaking news, analysis, and global coverage across politics, geopolitics, technology, science, and culture.

EL PAÍS English provides comprehensive English-language coverage of international affairs with particular focus on U.S.-Spain relations, European policy, Middle East conflicts, and emerging technologies. The publication features reporting from Madrid, Barcelona, and global correspondents alongside expert opinion on geopolitics and international relations.

## Key Topics

- Trump administration
- Geopolitics
- International relations
- Middle East conflict
- Pentagon funding
- US politics
- European policy
- Breaking news
- Global affairs
- Medical research
- AI and technology
- Current events
- World coverage
- International news
- Global politics

## News Sections

- [EL PAÍS English](https://english.elpais.com): Homepage with breaking news, opinion, and global coverage
- [International](https://english.elpais.com/international): International news covering global politics, geopolitics, and world affairs
- [U.S.](https://english.elpais.com/usa): U.S. and Latin America news covering politics, immigration, and foreign policy
- [Opinion](https://english.elpais.com/opinion): Opinion and analysis covering geopolitics, foreign policy, and international relations

## Business & Economy

- [Economy and Business](https://english.elpais.com/economy-and-business): Business and economy news covering trade, markets, and economic policy

## Science & Technology

- [Science](https://english.elpais.com/science-tech): Science and tech coverage including medical research, breakthroughs, and innovation
- [Technology](https://english.elpais.com/technology): Technology section covering AI, cybersecurity, privacy, and digital ethics
- [Health](https://english.elpais.com/health): Health news covering medical developments, medications, and wellness

## Environment & Climate

- [Climate](https://english.elpais.com/climate): Climate and environment coverage including change, sustainability, and disasters
